rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Humour entertains; satire criticises — identify the target of the joke in exam answers.
Quote the funny line, then explain what serious point it makes.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Q. What is the difference between humour and satire? (2 marks) — humour entertains; satire exposes and criticises folly through humour.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Distinguish the pair for the definition mark: humour amuses; satire CRITICISES through amusement — every unit question rewards naming the satire's TARGET.  ·  Trick 2: Identify the devices: irony, exaggeration (hyperbole), parody, sarcasm — name the device AND the sentence that shows it.

rows.text: Q. Name two satirical devices with an example from the text. (2 marks) — irony/hyperbole with the quoted line.
